description: Standalone ESP32-S3 wireless pentesting deck built on Bruce firmware alternate to Flipper Zero, supporting Wi-Fi, BLE, Sub-GHz (CC1101), nRF24L01, IR, NFC (PN532), and GPS-based wardriving for embedded security research.
